rationale: This change reaches the watched family only through the core/view/** selector, and only to add a macOS document-open seam to the platform shell: one new WindowHost virtual, set_open_files_handler, whose base implementation is a recorded unsupported-feature no-op, plus the macOS host's implementation in its own translation unit and the source-list wiring that carries it. It touches no design import, no render backend, no asset pipeline, and no raster or GPU path. Registered as watch-only so the family's coverage stays honest about a shell change that crossed its selector; no authority moves and no Vellum artifact changes.
